title: Timed Simulation of a Selected Branch
statement: Let $D,M_1,M_2$ be finite-state Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of the branch machine combining $M_1$ and $M_2$ on $x$. For any contents and head positions on $D$’s work tapes, any Boolean $b$, and any $t\in\mathbb N$, running the timed conditional machine for $t$ steps from the configuration embedding $c$, those tapes and head positions, and the bit $b$ yields exactly the embedded configuration obtained by running the branch machine, started in branch $b$, for $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Boolean machines D, M₁, and M₂
Input x and a configuration of the branch machine on x
Contents and head positions for D’s work tapes
Boolean b and natural number t
replaced:
Let $D,M_1,M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be an
input, and let $c$ be a configuration of the branch machine combining $M_1$ and $M_2$.
For any contents and head positions on $D$'s work tapes, any Boolean $b$, and any
$t\in\mathbb N$, running the timed conditional machine for $t$ steps from the
configuration that embeds $c$ together with those tapes and the bit $b$ yields exactly
the embedded configuration obtained by running the branch machine started in branch $b$
for $t$ steps.
